key.name: tile-left
key.summary: Tile left (from a right quarter: the matching left quarter)

key.name: tile-right
key.summary: Tile right (from a left quarter: the matching right quarter)

key.name: tile-up
key.summary: Maximize, or from a half: its top quarter

key.name: tile-down
key.summary: Restore, or from a half: its bottom quarter

key.name: drag-tiling
key.summary: Tile by dragging a window to a screen edge or corner

key.name: window-gap
key.summary: Gap around tiled windows, in pixels

key.name: fill-popup
key.summary: After tiling, offer other windows to fill the rest of the screen

key.name: fill-popup-all-workspaces
key.summary: The fill popup also lists windows from other workspaces

key.name: raise-together
key.summary: Focusing a tiled window raises the windows tiled with it

key.name: focus-hint
key.summary: Draw an outline around the focused window

key.name: migrated
key.summary: Tiling Assistant settings were copied (set once by the installer)

key.name: overridden-settings
key.summary: GNOME shortcuts and edge tiling as they were before this extension took them over (JSON; restored when it's disabled)
